PRELIMINARY MODEL ONLY: no structural pass/fail is issued. Uniform bearing ignores overturning; rib load sharing and the elastic bolt group are unverified assumptions. Bolt stresses use gross shank area, not threaded tensile area; equivalent solid diameter is NOT a selectable bolt size. Complete contact/uplift, threaded area, weld, anchor and concrete checks are required.

D = 154.1 mm legs are assumed equal in diameter, which is what makes the resultant sqrt(2) times one leg. H = 0.300 m and W_elbow = 50.0 kg are estimates: confirm them against the fabrication drawing and the supplier before construction.
The governing case was hydrostatic test pressure at 63.3 kN. Gravity is taken as 9.80665 m/s2, the same constant as the rest of the engine.

NOT covered here: concrete anchorage (ACI 318-25 ch. 17 breakout, pullout, pryout, side-blowout), plate bending at the bolt group (AISC Design Guide 1, frequently the governing plate check), rib shear and bearing, wind and seismic loads, and friction as a shear path - all of which can govern.
